verdict.rationale: The closest evidence is stablecoin subscriptions (private preview), which authorize recurring stablecoin withdrawals from customer wallets that then run without manual action. That is a narrow form of background automation, not a general way to set up autonomous automations. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow tooling, triggers and schedules beyond recurring billing, general availability (subscriptions are private preview only), documentation of how background runs are configured and monitored, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
